_fieldContract: Every `expression` and `field` here must name a field one of the load scripts creates. The load scripts alias raw lakehouse columns to display names (location_id AS [Distribution Center]), so a raw column name resolves to NULL in Qlik with no error and the KPI silently reads zero. Run `npm run lint:app-fields` after any edit; `node deploy/validate-app-fields.js --list` prints the available names. build-apps.js PREFERS this file over its own embedded spec whenever it exists.
